summary: CICS online Update User screen (admin function). Retrieves a user security record by user id, lets the admin edit the first name, last name, password and user type, validates the fields, and rewrites the record. Pseudo-conversational.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the update-user screen (or the user passed in from the list). On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return to admin menu; Enter fetch the user then validate+save edits; PF5 save; PF4 clear. Return to CICS.
branches: EVALUATE EIBAID: PF3 / PF4 / PF5 / ENTER

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Require and validate the user id, then read the user record. Validate the edited fields (first name, last name, password required; user type valid). If valid and changed, rewrite the user record; if the user id is not found, report it.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: to update a user, the id must exist and the edited name/password/type must be valid.

paragraphs.name: READ-USER-SEC-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the user security record by user id; on not-found set an error.

paragraphs.name: UPDATE-USER-SEC-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Rewrite the user security record with the edited fields; on error report it.

paragraphs.name: SEND-USRUPD-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and current user values and send the update-user map.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-USRUPD-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the update-user map from the terminal.

paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return to the admin menu / user list.
